page.layout: One printed page: running head at top with page number "92" at left and "DE VITA" centred; one column of running text; marginal notes in the left margin: "NB." beside the first paragraph, and "Caloris innati effectus & vires." beside the lower paragraphs.

main_text.p: interiora refugit, ob quod coctiones, sanguificationes & nutritiones magis procedunt, tempore vero æstivo idem calidum a sibi affinibus videlicet exterioribus ad extimas corporis partes evocatur, & ssoluitur atq; dissipatur, unde natura opera magis languent æstate, quàm hyeme. Cum enim calor innatus sit omnium naturalium operationum causa, s quitur, vbi is plurimus est & superabundat, cibi appetentiam intendi, coctionesq; melius procedere & felicius absolui.

p.i: At vero plurimum eum esse hiberno tempore validiores, atq; indicio sunt natura opera fortiora, coctiones enim augentur, plus generatur sanguinis, corpus efficitur crassius, superfluitatesq; in somno longioribus expurgantur, & omnia melius in corpore animalis administrantur tempore hiberno quàm æstate, quà calor circumfusus non tantum inutilia, sed etiam ea, quæ secundum naturam in corpore continentur, una diffluitionem quàm calor innatus operatur. Huius enim beneficio non tantum alimentum conficitur, singulisq; partibus proprium agglutinatur, verum etiam omnes superfluitates huius excernuntur atq; extenuantur, quedam exquisite per cutim, quæ vero in vapores convertuntur per expirationem, suffientem vero habentes crassitudinem per vrinas, in quibus etiam plus sedimenti est quàm per æstatem, propterea quod coctio felicius perficitur, corpora secundum carnem plus augentur, plus etiam boni sanguinis cumulatur.

page.notes: Marginal note "NB." stands at the first paragraph; the note "Caloris innati effectus & vires." stands beside the second paragraph. The text is a 16th/17th-century Latin printing in italic type; several words are doubtful due to damage and show-through, notably in the lower lines, and the final word "cumulatur" is partly illegible and has been read as best possible. Some words in the text are not certainly legible and should be checked against the scan.
